rating.comments: The student gives bare answers ("200", "1L", "yes") and no reasoning. The restatement "there is 200 students, one student use 1L of water every day, there are 300 days" only collects earlier inputs, and the student does not pick up the AI's point about days per week until the AI repeats it. The only question is the opening one, "How much water in litres do students consume...", which asks for the answer. "no please do it" pushes the calculation back to the AI, so effort is low.
